body.statement:
For a Lee--Gu BLCM with known latent dimension \(K\), a double-triangular
measurement adjacency matrix whose block indexed by
\((S_3)_{\mathrm{bin}}\) has no empty column identifies
\(\Gamma_{\mathrm{bin}}\); if the subset condition also holds, it identifies
\(\Lambda_{\mathrm{bin}}\) and \(P_{\mathrm{bin}}\), up to latent coordinate
permutation, binary state flips, and the latent Markov equivalence class.

source.locator: Theorem 2 (Identifiability of model components), Section 3.1 of arXiv version 2
